messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: Need clean integration with supplier portals to pull in supplier data without breaking existing reporting.
  quote: Perfect. We also need clean integrations with our supplier portals — can your system pull in supplier data without breaking our existing reporting?
- problem: The current suppliers section does not support streamlined vendor payments.
  quote: are there any upcoming updates to the suppliers section? We’re hoping to streamline our vendor payments soon.
- problem: The product lacks a feature to automate reserves and supplier reconciliations, forcing manual work.
  quote: We’ve been waiting for that feature to reduce manual work on reserves and supplier reconciliations.
- problem: User cannot pull the latest supplier reports into the system.
  quote: I’m having trouble pulling the latest supplier reports into the system — any idea what might be blocking it?
- problem: The current product does not adequately support increasingly complex supplier integrations and reporting.
  quote: That’s exactly what we need — especially with supplier integrations and reporting getting more complex each quarter.
